abstract: OBJECTIVE: To study the incidence of malignant change, diagnosis and management of mature cystic teratomas in postmenopausal women. METHODS: Twenty cases of mature cystic teratoma in postmenopausal women admitted to our hospital between January 1977 and January 1997 was retrospectively reviewed and evaluated. RESULTS: The number of postmenopausal patients with mature cystic teratoma (20) accounted for 7.6% of the total number of patients with benign ovarian teratomas (263). There were 3 cases of malignant change, which were squamous carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, and digestive gland epithelial carcinoma. The incidence of malignant change was 15%. CONCLUSION: In postmenopausal women, mature ovarian cystic teratoma should be treated as lowly malignant and should be paid much attention.
abstract_ja: 目的：閉経後女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化の頻度、診断、管理を検討する。方法：1977年1月から1997年1月までに当院に入院した閉経後女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫20例を後方視的に検討し、評価した。結果：閉経後の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫20例は、良性卵巣奇形腫263例の7.6%を占めた。悪性転化は3例で、扁平上皮癌、癌肉腫、消化腺上皮癌であった。悪性転化の頻度は15%であった。結論：閉経後女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は低悪性度として扱い、十分な注意を払うべきである。
